verse.verse_1: When the heaven is cleft asunder.
verse.verse_2: And when the stars have fallen and scattered;
verse.verse_3: And when the seas are burst forth (got dried up);
verse.verse_4: And when the graves are turned upside down (and they bring out their contents)
verse.verse_5: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).
verse.verse_6: O man! What has made you careless concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
verse.verse_7: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion;
verse.verse_8: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.
verse.verse_9: Nay! But you deny the Recompense (reward for good deeds and punishment for evil deeds).
verse.verse_10: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you.
verse.verse_12: They know all that you do.
verse.verse_13: Verily, the Abrar (pious and righteous) will be in delight (Paradise);
verse.verse_14: And verily, the Fujjar (the wicked, disbelievers, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),
verse.verse_15: In which they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,
verse.verse_16: And they (Al-Fujjar) will not be absent therefrom (i.e. will not go out from the Hell).
verse.verse_17: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
verse.verse_18: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
verse.verse_19: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
